mapper.select: SELECT stat_date AS date, COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS count FROM kb_document_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT s.document_id AS document_id, MAX(s.document_title) AS document_title, COALESCE(SUM(s.view_count), 0) AS total_views, COALESCE(SUM(s.like_count), 0) AS total_likes, COALESCE(SUM(s.comment_count), 0) AS total_comments FROM kb_document_statistics s WHERE s.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY s.document_id ORDER BY total_views DESC LIMIT #{limit}
